_seed.what_this_is: A fresh-start seed for Finn (portfolio intelligence system). This is the DATA file. The engine (system prompt + 8 skills + visual system + templates) is separate and ships unchanged.
_seed.edition: runtime (no dev/build docs). To extend Finn later, add the optional dev_pack files listed in _meta.dev_pack — nothing else needs rewiring.
_seed.tier: B — engine + a starter AI/semiconductor playbook. The previous operator's watchlist, conviction framework, adjacency/read-through maps, and scoring/review methodology are carried as EXAMPLES so you can see a working setup. No positions, P&L, NAV history, scores, curated price targets, reviews, or call history travel with it.
_seed.example_convention: Anything carrying inherited content is flagged "_example": true (on the object, or at the section root for whole-section examples). Examples are safe to keep, edit, or delete.
how_to_make_it_yours: 1. Set your config in `portfolio` (starting NAV, milestones, cash) and clear the anchors.
2. Add your real positions to `positions` as you buy (schema shown in `_example_position`).
3. Keep / edit / delete the example watchlist + maps to match your universe.
4. Or skip all of that and WIPE — see wipe_options below.

wipe_options.command: In Finn, type `wipe` (or `reset` / `fresh start`). Finn confirms once, then outputs a clean FINN_STATE.json with every `_example` block removed and all live sections empty. Upload that as your FINN_STATE.json.
wipe_options.file_swap: Or just use the shipped FINN_STATE.blank.json (same schema, examples already removed) as your FINN_STATE.json.
wipe_options.manual: Or delete every object/section flagged `_example` by hand.

_seed.not_included_personal: positions, trades, nav_history, realized P&L, CS/MS score values, curated price targets, review entries, call-log history, live macro snapshot, open decisions, session handoff, exit/post-sell ledger — all stripped.
_seed.data_integrity_note: Finn never displays a price without a live source. This file holds NO prices. All quotes come from the operator's own FMP connector at render.

_meta.read_first: Load this file at the start of every session (GMF). All portfolio data lives here. The system prompt is the brain; this is the state.
_meta.edit_rule: One canonical state file. Update it the same response any decision is made. Re-upload to the Project after changes (and to your backup repo if you keep one).
runtime_files: skills/ (8 modules: fmp-feed, scoring, monitoring, frameworks, daily-surfaces, report-surfaces, sync, visual-system)

dev_pack._note: OPTIONAL. Add these to the Project only to build/extend Finn (e.g. the Phase-3 app). Runtime works without them; the prompt references them as optional so adding them is a clean drop-in.

portfolio._set_these: Replace the placeholders below with your own values, then clear this note.
portfolio.broker: your broker (NAV reconciles off your broker's EOD close)

anchors._note: Quick-reference snapshot Finn cross-checks at sync. Empty until you add positions and capture your first EOD NAV.

_example_position._note: Field shape for a position. Delete this key; add real entries to the `positions` array.
_example_position.name: Company Name

fmp_targets._note: Your curated price targets per ticker (your judgment, not street consensus). Empty by design — add as you build conviction.

_example.note: why this PT differs from street, if it does

_trade_schema._note: Trade-log shape (kept oldest -> newest). Delete this key.

_nav_history_note: Append one entry per captured EOD close: {date, nav, source:'broker', note}. This builds your progress curve.

scores._note: Methodology config is kept (this is how Finn scores). All score VALUES are stripped — rescore your own names.
scores.system_note: Dual rating: CS (Conviction Score, 1-100, durable thesis quality) + MS (Momentum/Setup Score, 1-100, timing). Live CS/MS per owned name live on each `positions` entry. Snapshots archived in history[].

thesis.thesis: Dominant AI compute platform; CUDA moat + supply-constrained datacenter GPU demand.
Custom AI silicon (ASIC) + networking; multi-hyperscaler design wins compounding.
AI back-end Ethernet networking leader; share gains as clusters scale.
WFE leverage to the entire AI buildout; picks-and-shovels to every fab.
AI datacenter/neocloud infra; large contracted backlog re-rated the story.
Core index foundation — a dollar anchor, not a thesis trade.

_thesis_note: Examples show the one-line-thesis pattern + the analytical voice. Replace with your own names.

reviews._note: Trigger rules + patterns are methodology (kept). Specific review entries are stripped.
reviews.trigger_rules: WIN +40% / LOSS -20% / any full exit. Open reviews carry as TODO.

questions: Was sizing right for the conviction?
Trim/exit discipline — early, late, or right?

reviews.open_todo: Add a LOSS-review template the first time a name hits -20%.

watchlist._note: STARTER AI/semis universe inherited from the previous operator. Keep, prune, or replace. This whole section is an example — `wipe` clears it entirely.

post_sell_monitor.note: 30-day post-exit re-entry watch — Finn flags if it hits the zone before expiry

canonical_tiers_named._note: The previous operator's tier taxonomy. Color-coded sections used by the watchlist dashboard.

names.name: Rocket Lab
names.thesis: Defense + launch; Neutron program; dilution risk to watch.

adjacent_map._note: When an owned name moves, these adjacents often move with it — Finn scans them for read-through and entry ideas.

gameplan._note: Standing buy intents at defined zones (no DCA — adds on dips only).

macro._note: Live market snapshot is stripped (it's dated). The analytical MAPS below are scaffolding and are kept as examples.

read_through_map._note: Earnings/news from key tickers that read through to your book. Edit to your universe.

smart_money: congress + notable funds (edit to your watchlist of investors)
macro.scaffolding_note: The engine scans adjacents + read-through + smart-money every session, materiality-scores for the book, and diffs vs last_scan.

_open_decisions_note: Live forks awaiting your call (add zone, trim decision, etc.). Empty at start.

session_handoff._note: Written at the end of each session (GNF) and read at the start of the next (GMF). Empty at start.

calls_log._note: Finn's actionable calls + confidence + (later) outcome grades. The mechanic is methodology; history is stripped.

news_watch._note: Targets the news engine tracks. Maps live in macro. Empty live results at start.

last_scan._note: Last news/smart-money scan result, for session-over-session diffing. Empty at start.

clusters._note: Concentration view by sub-theme. Computed from your positions — empty until you hold names.

risk._note: Concentration + sizing guardrails. Set ceilings to taste.
risk.notes: Example ceiling: trim any single name back under 20% of NAV.

fundamentals._note: Per-ticker fundamentals you web-source for scenario pages/reports (FMP Starter gives annuals only). Empty at start.

catalysts._note: Earnings + macro calendar. Owned-name dates are stripped; the AUTO-FIRE rules (methodology) are kept.
catalysts.auto_fire_rules: A scenario page fires automatically when ANY is true: (a) an owned name has earnings <7 days, (b) a major catalyst on an owned name, (c) a price target is breached, (d) a live decision fork.
